estimate.pricing_description: For 16:9 video without video input, your request costs roughly $0.2056 per second of generated video at 480p, $0.4622 at 720p, and $1.1372 at 1080p. Each 1,000 video tokens costs $0.0214 at 480p or 720p and $0.0234 at 1080p. Billable video tokens = ceil(output height × output width × (input video duration + generated video duration) × 24 / 1024). Image and audio references do not count as video input. Actual pricing depends on output dimensions and billable duration. Rates shown are before any applicable customer discount.
